correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the necessary and sufficient regularity criterion by image-intersection and a flag-preserving section, then counted exactly q^(ab-ij) admissible off-diagonal blocks by surjectivity of a linear restriction map. The standard rank enumeration yields p_q,n(i). Product-tail estimates prove the stated TV rates; strict likelihood-ratio monotonicity gives negative association. Finite enumeration checked all defect strata in six configurations (6574 matrices), with actual generalized-inverse witness searches for 163 matrices.

value.rationale: This is the complete joint defect-resolved von Neumann regularity distribution for all two-block finite-field subspace-preserving transformation monoids; it gives a nontrivial dimension-stable nonregularity density and explains a strict induced negative dependence between otherwise independent block-nullities. A full natural invariant and a quantifiable asymptotic change in stochastic structure are useful beyond isolated counts or a restatement of the known elementwise criterion.
